ALLEN.role: Gatekeeper, integrator, and seed coordinator. Authors the integration layer and this hook; gates every contribution before it is applied.

GEMINI.role: Contributor. Authored the gated HALEX-AI module suite staged under workspace/gemini; contributions are applied only after Allen's confirmation gate.

note: Agencies are the AI systems contributing to HALEX-AI. Each agency runs under its own ZINIUM seed marker. Registering an agency here means the coordinator will accept envelopes carrying its marker; the marker is a public provenance label, not a credential, and acceptance is not authentication of who created an envelope. Add an agency by adding one entry; never remove or rename an existing entry, so old envelopes stay interpretable.
